//go:build integration
// +build integration

package integration

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/infrastructure/persistence/postgres"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

func TestExactPathPlanningPreservesProgressAndOtherSelectedPath(t *testing.T) {
	pool := getTestDBPool(t)
	defer pool.Close()
	ctx := context.Background()
	studentID := uuid.NewString()
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		_, _ = pool.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM student_learning_context WHERE student_id=$1`, studentID)
		_, _ = pool.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM student_learning_path_request WHERE student_id=$1`, studentID)
		_, _ = pool.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM student_learning_path WHERE student_id=$1`, studentID)
	})
	repo := &postgres.LearningJourneyRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	now := time.Now().UTC()

	first := integrationLearningPath(studentID, uuid.NewString(), uuid.NewString(), uuid.NewString(), now)
	first.Items = []domain.LearningPathItem{
		{ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: uuid.NewString(), Position: 0, Status: domain.LearningPathItemCompleted, ReasonCode: "course_completed", Targets: []domain.LearningTargetRef{{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.old", Version: "v1"}}},
		{ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: uuid.NewString(), Position: 1, Status: domain.LearningPathItemCompleted, ReasonCode: "course_completed"},
		{ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: uuid.NewString(), Position: 2, Status: domain.LearningPathItemPlanned, ReasonCode: "later"},
	}
	first, _, err := repo.CreateLearningPathIdempotently(ctx, first, repository.LearningPathCreationRequest{
		IdempotencyKey: uuid.NewString(), PlanningRequestID: uuid.NewString(), RequestHash: strings.Repeat("1", 64),
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create first path: %v", err)
	}
	if _, err := repo.GetLearningPathPlanningState(ctx, uuid.NewString(), first.ID); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		t.Fatalf("foreign planning-state read error=%v, want not found", err)
	}
	second, _, err := repo.CreateLearningPathIdempotently(ctx,
		integrationLearningPath(studentID, uuid.NewString(), uuid.NewString(), uuid.NewString(), now.Add(time.Second)),
		repository.LearningPathCreationRequest{
			IdempotencyKey: uuid.NewString(), PlanningRequestID: uuid.NewString(), RequestHash: strings.Repeat("2", 64),
		})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create second path: %v", err)
	}
	if _, err := repo.ActivateLearningPath(ctx, studentID, second.ID, 2, false, now.Add(2*time.Second)); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("select second path: %v", err)
	}
	secondBefore, err := repo.GetLearningPathByID(ctx, studentID, second.ID)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read second path: %v", err)
	}

	sameCourseDesired := []domain.LearningPathItem{
		{ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: first.Items[0].ReferenceID, Position: 0, Status: domain.LearningPathItemPlanned, ReasonCode: "planner_refresh", Targets: []domain.LearningTargetRef{{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.new", Version: "v2"}}},
		{ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: first.Items[1].ReferenceID, Position: 1, Status: domain.LearningPathItemPlanned, ReasonCode: "planner_refresh"},
		{ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: first.Items[2].ReferenceID, Position: 2, Status: domain.LearningPathItemReady, ReasonCode: "next_gap"},
	}
	sameCourseReplan := integrationPlanningCommand(
		first, domain.LearningPathPlanningCommandReplan, 1, sameCourseDesired, now.Add(3*time.Second), "a",
	)
	sameCourseResult, replayed, err := repo.ApplyLearningPathPlanningCommand(ctx, sameCourseReplan)
	if err != nil || replayed || !sameCourseResult.Changed || sameCourseResult.State.PathVersion != 2 ||
		sameCourseResult.State.JourneyVersion != 4 || sameCourseResult.State.IsSelected {
		t.Fatalf("replan exact unselected path: result=%+v replayed=%v err=%v", sameCourseResult, replayed, err)
	}
	if sameCourseResult.State.Items[0].Status != domain.LearningPathItemCompleted ||
		sameCourseResult.State.Items[1].Status != domain.LearningPathItemCompleted ||
		sameCourseResult.State.Items[2].Status != domain.LearningPathItemReady {
		t.Fatalf("progress regressed during replan: %+v", sameCourseResult.State.Items)
	}
	if len(sameCourseResult.State.Items[0].Targets) != 1 || sameCourseResult.State.Items[0].Targets[0].Key != "go.old" {
		t.Fatalf("progressed item target drifted: %+v", sameCourseResult.State.Items[0])
	}
	secondAfter, _ := repo.GetLearningPathByID(ctx, studentID, second.ID)
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(secondBefore, secondAfter) {
		t.Fatalf("replan mutated selected second path: before=%+v after=%+v", secondBefore, secondAfter)
	}

	newCourseID := uuid.NewString()
	newFingerprint := "fingerprint-v2"
	// Accepted Hybrid ADR preserves completed history and only adapts future
	// work at the ordinary boundary. Active-work rejection has a dedicated proof.
	newCourseDesired := []domain.LearningPathItem{
		{ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: first.Items[0].ReferenceID, Position: 0, Status: domain.LearningPathItemPlanned, ReasonCode: "planner_refresh"},
		{ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: first.Items[1].ReferenceID, Position: 1, Status: domain.LearningPathItemPlanned, ReasonCode: "planner_refresh"},
		{ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: uuid.NewString(), Position: 2, Status: domain.LearningPathItemReady, ReasonCode: "first_current_gap"},
	}
	newCourseReplan := integrationPlanningCommand(
		first, domain.LearningPathPlanningCommandReplan, 2, newCourseDesired, now.Add(4*time.Second), "b",
	)
	newCourseReplan.CourseID = newCourseID
	newCourseReplan.CourseFingerprint = newFingerprint
	newCourseResult, replayed, err := repo.ApplyLearningPathPlanningCommand(ctx, newCourseReplan)
	if err != nil || replayed || !newCourseResult.Changed || newCourseResult.State.PathVersion != 3 ||
		newCourseResult.State.JourneyVersion != 5 || newCourseResult.State.CourseID != newCourseID ||
		newCourseResult.State.CourseFingerprint != newFingerprint {
		t.Fatalf("replace exact path Course identity: result=%+v replayed=%v err=%v", newCourseResult, replayed, err)
	}
	if newCourseResult.State.Items[0].Status != domain.LearningPathItemCompleted ||
		newCourseResult.State.Items[0].ReferenceID != first.Items[0].ReferenceID ||
		newCourseResult.State.Items[2].Status != domain.LearningPathItemReady {
		t.Fatalf("progress crossed a non-matching new-Course reference: %+v", newCourseResult.State.Items)
	}
	secondAfterNewCourse, _ := repo.GetLearningPathByID(ctx, studentID, second.ID)
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(secondBefore, secondAfterNewCourse) {
		t.Fatalf("new-Course replan mutated selected second path: before=%+v after=%+v", secondBefore, secondAfterNewCourse)
	}

	current := first
	current.CourseID = newCourseID
	current.CurriculumRevision = newFingerprint
	current.CourseFingerprint = newFingerprint
	noOp := integrationPlanningCommand(
		current, domain.LearningPathPlanningCommandReplan, 3, newCourseDesired, now.Add(5*time.Second), "c",
	)
	noOp.PlannerPolicyVersion = newCourseReplan.PlannerPolicyVersion
	noOp.ReasonCode = newCourseReplan.ReasonCode
	noOp.ReasonSummary = newCourseReplan.ReasonSummary
	noOpResult, _, err := repo.ApplyLearningPathPlanningCommand(ctx, noOp)
	if err != nil || noOpResult.Changed || noOpResult.State.PathVersion != 3 || noOpResult.State.JourneyVersion != 5 {
		t.Fatalf("no-op replan changed versions: %+v err=%v", noOpResult, err)
	}

	stale := integrationPlanningCommand(
		current, domain.LearningPathPlanningCommandReplan, 2, newCourseDesired, now.Add(6*time.Second), "d",
	)
	if _, _, err := repo.ApplyLearningPathPlanningCommand(ctx, stale); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) {
		t.Fatalf("stale exact-path version error=%v, want conflict", err)
	}

	noGap := integrationPlanningCommand(current, domain.LearningPathPlanningCommandNoGap, 3, nil, now.Add(7*time.Second), "e")
	noGap.Schema = domain.LearningPathNoGapRequestSchema
	noGap.ReasonCode = "mastery_no_gap"
	noGap.ReasonSummary = "All targets already mastered"
	completed, replayed, err := repo.ApplyLearningPathPlanningCommand(ctx, noGap)
	if err != nil || replayed || !completed.Changed || completed.State.Status != domain.LearningPathStatusCompleted ||
		completed.State.PathVersion != 4 || completed.State.JourneyVersion != 6 {
		t.Fatalf("complete exact path: result=%+v replayed=%v err=%v", completed, replayed, err)
	}
	for _, item := range completed.State.Items {
		if item.Status != domain.LearningPathItemCompleted && item.Status != domain.LearningPathItemSkippedMastered {
			t.Fatalf("NO_GAP left nonterminal item: %+v", item)
		}
	}
	contextValue, _ := repo.GetLearningContext(ctx, studentID)
	if contextValue.SelectedLearningPathID != second.ID || contextValue.Version != 6 {
		t.Fatalf("NO_GAP changed the other selected path: %+v", contextValue)
	}
	secondAfterCompletion, _ := repo.GetLearningPathByID(ctx, studentID, second.ID)
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(secondBefore, secondAfterCompletion) {
		t.Fatalf("NO_GAP mutated another path: before=%+v after=%+v", secondBefore, secondAfterCompletion)
	}
	noGap.OccurredAt = now.Add(8 * time.Second)
	completionReplay, replayed, err := repo.ApplyLearningPathPlanningCommand(ctx, noGap)
	if err != nil || !replayed || !reflect.DeepEqual(completionReplay, completed) {
		t.Fatalf("NO_GAP replay was not exact: result=%+v replayed=%v err=%v", completionReplay, replayed, err)
	}
	newCourseReplan.OccurredAt = now.Add(9 * time.Second)
	replanReplay, replayed, err := repo.ApplyLearningPathPlanningCommand(ctx, newCourseReplan)
	if err != nil || !replayed || !reflect.DeepEqual(replanReplay, newCourseResult) {
		t.Fatalf("new-Course replan replay did not return original response: result=%+v replayed=%v err=%v", replanReplay, replayed, err)
	}
	contextValue, _ = repo.GetLearningContext(ctx, studentID)
	if contextValue.Version != 6 {
		t.Fatalf("old replan replay changed current journey version: %+v", contextValue)
	}
}

func integrationPlanningCommand(
	path domain.StudentLearningPath,
	kind domain.LearningPathPlanningCommandKind,
	expectedVersion int64,
	desired []domain.LearningPathItem,
	now time.Time,
	hashDigit string,
) domain.LearningPathPlanningCommand {
	return domain.LearningPathPlanningCommand{
		Schema: domain.LearningPathReplanRequestSchema, Kind: kind, StudentID: path.StudentID,
		LearningPathID: path.ID, PlanningRequestID: uuid.NewString(), IdempotencyKey: uuid.NewString(),
		CourseID: path.CourseID, GoalCode: path.GoalCode, CourseFingerprint: path.CourseFingerprint,
		PlannerPolicyVersion: "planner-v2", ReasonCode: "replan", ReasonSummary: "Refresh route",
		ExpectedPathVersion: expectedVersion, DesiredItems: desired,
		RequestHash: strings.Repeat(hashDigit, 64), OccurredAt: now,
	}
}
